body: Fix macOS CI failure in test/scheduler.test.mjs where refs/namespaces/attempts/t2/rebased pre-exists on a case-insensitive filesystem (APFS) and causes git push to refs/namespaces/attempts/T2/... to resolve on disk as attempts/t2/..., triggering Unauthorized or unregistered attempt namespace modified in verifyRootGitIntegrity. Lowercase t.id in attemptSlug (matching tempRef) and compare attemptNamespace, knownAttemptNamespaces, and activeAttemptNamespaces case-insensitively in verifyRootGitIntegrity, with unit test coverage.
title: Normalize attempt namespace case in scheduler and verifyRootGitIntegrity for case-insensitive filesystems
